description: developer-harness guard hooks (Claude Code dialect). Two layers: safety guards that see every tool call (dangerous shell commands, protected paths), and commit hygiene guards narrowed to `git commit` (secrets, large files, merge markers, quality gate). Declared explicitly in .claude-plugin/plugin.json; deliberately NOT named hooks/hooks.json, which other tools (Codex) auto-discover and parse with their own schema — see hooks/codex.hooks.json and hooks/README.md. instruction-scan.sh, agents-md-budget.sh, and done-authority-gate.sh are documented opt-ins and are intentionally absent here.
